notes.title: NEKO-NIN exHeart Chinese version released! Nin♪
notes.notes:
Yes, it's finally here! The Chinese release of NEKO-NIN is done~ 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340451/7e5949a69532eaeb1adafc31c9288456768e17ad.jpg[/img]

There is a simple guide on how to enable Chinese language!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340451/1a202e8cefdca9ab9050043597fb8d722988783b.png[/img]
Open config

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340451/0d4db30e92c818c411ca293aeb34c830fd0075c7.png[/img]
Go to System2 and click language

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340451/a19bff071176f043e4ad6b8444a6a4a329bd6f2d.png[/img]
Select Chinese

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340451/2ea1da0a55f1cef4bb3a076f935cfcc941b89207.png[/img]
Chinese text is now enabled~!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340451/84cdba59a9d6b55a0267db59bb07540ba4e1311f.png[/img]
Yura and Tama are waiting for you~ Nin~!
